text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what actually happened.

The wins: reps reclaimed about 5 hours a week on CRM updates. Follow-up emails went out same-day instead of three days later. Managers finally saw what was said in deals, not just what got logged.

The surprises: customers asked about recording more than we expected. Reps who disclosed upfront and explained why built more trust, not less. Summaries missed nuance, like a buyer's hesitation, so reps still had to add their own read.

The lesson: AI captured the conversation, but reps still owned the judgment.

Next quarter, we're expanding the pilot and training on disclosure.

What's your team learned from AI tools in the field?
